messages.risk.directory.summary: Record project risks, track them by status, and review them when due.
messages.risk.empty.body: Record what could go wrong and see it by impact and likelihood.
messages.risk.empty.title: No risks yet
messages.risk.error.failed: That didn’t finish. Try again in a moment.
messages.risk.error.no-answer: No response came back. Check your connection and try again.
messages.risk.field.title: Title
messages.risk.filter.no-kind: No linked risks to filter by yet
messages.risk.form.required: Title and description are both required
messages.risk.form.statement-hint: When it could happen, and what follows if it does
messages.risk.form.title-hint: In one line, what could go wrong
messages.risk.form.treatment-hint: How you plan to reduce, transfer, or accept it
messages.risk.grid.label: Impact {impact}, likelihood {likelihood}
messages.risk.overview.failed-body: This doesn’t mean there are none. Try again in a moment.
messages.risk.overview.no-match-body: Change the filters, or clear them to see all.
messages.risk.overview.title: Project risks
messages.risk.record.closed-body: Closed {when}. Reopen it to keep following up.
messages.risk.record.conflict: This risk was just updated elsewhere
messages.risk.record.conflict-body: Compare them: keep the current version, or continue your edits on top of it.
messages.risk.record.read-only-body: You can’t edit risks in this project.
messages.risk.record.standalone: This risk stands on its own; you can also link it to what it affects.
messages.risk.review.focus-hint: Leave empty to review the whole risk
messages.risk.review.left: The risk is closed, but its review couldn’t be canceled. Cancel it in Schedule.
messages.risk.review.no-reads: The review can’t read this risk yet
messages.risk.review.no-reads-body: When it’s due, it reads only what you granted this task. Grant read access in Schedule.
messages.risk.review.no-result: The last turn left no finding
messages.risk.review.none: No review scheduled. When it’s due, the background assistant checks it once and suggests next steps without changing this risk itself.
messages.risk.review.none-closed: The risk is closed; no more reviews.
messages.risk.review.reads-attention-body: A grant is waiting for confirmation or no longer available, so the review may not be able to read this risk.
messages.risk.review.reads-ok: Read access is granted; the review can read this risk when due.
messages.risk.review.reads-unknown: Can’t tell what this review can read right now.
messages.risk.review.title: Review
messages.risk.review.unavailable-body: Recurring reviews run via Schedule. Enable Schedule in this project or check your access.
messages.risk.side.idle-body: Open a risk from somewhere else and it opens here first.
messages.risk.help.title: Risk
messages.risk.help.what: Track project risks, impact levels, mitigations, and review check-ins so critical blockers are never forgotten.
messages.risk.help.example-1: Log a release or dependency risk with triggers and a mitigation plan
messages.risk.help.example-2: Filter open high-impact risks and close them once mitigated
messages.risk.help.scope: Risk entries stay in this project’s local database; optional review reminders trigger locally under your permission.
messages.risk.help.advanced: Cross-reference goals so high-severity risks are double-checked before goal closure.
messages.risk.directory.name: Risk
